prompt: The attached image is a 244x240 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Yellow creature scene</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 244px; height: 240px; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; }
  canvas { display: block; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 244px; height: 240px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const W = 244, H = 240;

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(W, H);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xffffff);

// ---------- Camera (reference view) ----------
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(22, W / H, 0.1, 100);
camera.position.set(0, 2.41, 10.29);
camera.lookAt(0, 2.41, 0);

// ---------- Lights (readable from every side) ----------
const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xb89a78, 2.2);
hemi.name = 'light-hemi';
scene.add(hemi);

const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.6);
key.name = 'light-key';
key.position.set(3, 6, 10);
scene.add(key);

const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff2dd, 1.0);
fill.name = 'light-fill-left';
fill.position.set(-10, 2, 6);
scene.add(fill);

const fillR = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
fillR.name = 'light-fill-right';
fillR.position.set(10, 2, -2);
scene.add(fillR);

const back = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.8);
back.name = 'light-back';
back.position.set(0, 5, -10);
scene.add(back);

// ---------- Floor (white with soft grey contact shadow gradient) ----------
const environment = new THREE.Group();
environment.name = 'environment';
scene.add(environment);
{
  const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = 64; cv.height = 64;
  const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
  const gr = ctx.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 0, 32, 32, 32);
  gr.addColorStop(0.0, '#8c8c8c');
  gr.addColorStop(0.2, '#bdbdbd');
  gr.addColorStop(0.42, '#d6d6d6');
  gr.addColorStop(0.94, '#ffffff');
  gr.addColorStop(1.0, '#ffffff');
  ctx.fillStyle = gr;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv);
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.PlaneGeometry(16, 16),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex })
  );
  floor.name = 'floor';
  floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  floor.position.y = 0;
  environment.add(floor);
}

// ---------- Materials ----------
const YELLOW = '#ffc330';
const BELLY = '#e2c8ae';
const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.6, metalness: 0 });
const headMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: YELLOW, roughness: 0.6, metalness: 0 });
const armMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#ffb82a', roughness: 0.62, metalness: 0 });
const handMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#4a3420', roughness: 0.6, metalness: 0 });
const beakMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#f39a1f', roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0 });
const mouthMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#8a3a12', roughness: 0.7, metalness: 0 });
const eyeMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#0c0a08', roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0 });

const unitSphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 32, 24);
function ell(mat, sx, sy, sz, x, y, z, name) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(unitSphere, mat);
  m.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
  m.position.set(x, y, z);
  if (name) m.name = name;
  return m;
}

// ---------- Character ----------
const character = new THREE.Group();
character.name = 'character-yellow-creature';
scene.add(character);

// Body: pear-shaped lathe with belly patch painted via vertex colours
const bodyGroup = new THREE.Group();
bodyGroup.name = 'body';
character.add(bodyGroup);
{
  // [y, r]
  const prof = [
    [0.00, 0.00], [0.02, 0.50], [0.14, 0.92], [0.45, 1.24], [0.90, 1.40],
    [1.45, 1.43], [2.00, 1.34], [2.40, 1.17], [2.80, 0.93], [3.10, 0.77],
    [3.35, 0.67], [3.60, 0.60], [3.85, 0.46], [4.00, 0.00]
  ];
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
    prof.map(p => new THREE.Vector3(p[1], p[0], 0)), false, 'centripetal'
  );
  const pts = curve.getPoints(140).map(v => new THREE.Vector2(Math.max(0, v.x), Math.max(0, v.y)));
  pts[0].set(0, 0);
  pts[pts.length - 1].x = 0;
  const geo = new THREE.LatheGeometry(pts, 128);

  const pos = geo.attributes.position;
  const colors = new Float32Array(pos.count * 3);
  const cY = new THREE.Color(YELLOW), cB = new THREE.Color(BELLY), c = new THREE.Color();
  for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
    const x = pos.getX(i), y = pos.getY(i), z = pos.getZ(i);
    let m = 0;
    if (z > 0) {
      const d = Math.hypot(x / 0.62, (y - 2.07) / 0.78);
      m = 1 - THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(d, 0.8, 1.08);
    }
    c.copy(cY).lerp(cB, m);
    colors[i * 3] = c.r; colors[i * 3 + 1] = c.g; colors[i * 3 + 2] = c.b;
  }
  geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  const torso = new THREE.Mesh(geo, bodyMat);
  torso.name = 'torso';
  bodyGroup.add(torso);
}

// Head
const head = new THREE.Group();
head.name = 'head';
head.position.set(0, 3.72, 0);
character.add(head);
{
  const skull = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.62, 48, 32), headMat);
  skull.name = 'head-sphere';
  head.add(skull);

  // Eyes
  const eyes = new THREE.Group();
  eyes.name = 'eyes';
  head.add(eyes);
  const zAxis = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);
  [['eye-right', -1], ['eye-left', 1]].forEach(([name, s]) => {
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    g.name = name;
    const n = new THREE.Vector3(s * 0.24, 0.24, 0.519).normalize();
    g.position.copy(n).multiplyScalar(0.612);
    g.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(zAxis, n);
    const ball = ell(eyeMat, 0.062, 0.09, 0.035, 0, 0, 0, name + '-ball');
    g.add(ball);
    eyes.add(g);
  });

  // Beak / mouth
  const mouth = new THREE.Group();
  mouth.name = 'mouth';
  head.add(mouth);
  const upper = new THREE.Group();
  upper.name = 'beak-upper';
  upper.add(ell(beakMat, 0.24, 0.075, 0.22, 0, 0, 0, 'beak-upper-mesh'));
  upper.position.set(0, -0.07, 0.64);
  mouth.add(upper);
  const lower = new THREE.Group();
  lower.name = 'beak-lower';
  lower.add(ell(beakMat, 0.2, 0.055, 0.18, 0, 0, 0, 'beak-lower-mesh'));
  lower.position.set(0, -0.15, 0.6);
  mouth.add(lower);
  mouth.add(ell(mouthMat, 0.215, 0.022, 0.19, 0, -0.115, 0.615, 'mouth-line'));
}

// Arms
function makeArm(name, shoulder, handPos) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = 'arm-' + name;
  g.position.copy(shoulder);
  const dir = handPos.clone().sub(shoulder);
  const len = dir.length();
  dir.normalize();
  g.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dir);

  const L = len - 0.12;
  const limb = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.22, L, 8, 24), armMat);
  limb.name = 'arm-' + name + '-limb';
  limb.position.y = L / 2;
  g.add(limb);

  const hand = new THREE.Group();
  hand.name = 'hand-' + name;
  hand.position.y = len;
  const inward = -Math.sign(shoulder.x);
  hand.add(ell(handMat, 0.28, 0.27, 0.26, 0, 0.02, 0, 'hand-' + name + '-fist'));
  hand.add(ell(handMat, 0.11, 0.14, 0.11, inward * 0.2, 0.0, 0.15, 'hand-' + name + '-thumb'));
  g.add(hand);
  return g;
}
// character's right arm is on the viewer's left
const armRight = makeArm('right', new THREE.Vector3(-1.0, 2.0, 0.55), new THREE.Vector3(-0.83, 2.90, 0.78));
const armLeft = makeArm('left', new THREE.Vector3(1.05, 2.05, 0.5), new THREE.Vector3(1.40, 3.04, 0.6));
character.add(armRight);
character.add(armLeft);

// Feet (hidden below the frame in the reference view, but give the volume a base)
const feet = new THREE.Group();
feet.name = 'feet';
character.add(feet);
[['foot-right', -1], ['foot-left', 1]].forEach(([name, s]) => {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = name;
  g.position.set(s * 0.55, 0.14, 0.85);
  g.add(ell(armMat, 0.42, 0.14, 0.55, 0, 0, 0, name + '-mesh'));
  feet.add(g);
});

// ---------- Harness contract ----------
function render(t) {
  // static pose: t is ignored for this step
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
render(0);

window.nwb = {
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras: { ref: camera },
  characters: [character],
  render,
  ready: true
};
</script>
</body>
</html>
